It read simply: \"If you are reading this, the storm has passed, and I am finally safe on the other shore.\" Arthur stared at the ink, wondering who had thrown it into the churning surf, and whether they had ever truly found the peace they sought.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市，褪去了白日的喧嚣，只剩下路灯拉长的影子和偶尔驶过的清扫车。空气中带着一丝湿润的凉意，整座城市仿佛陷入了沉睡，唯有高楼上的零星灯火还在无声地诉说著不眠的故事。远处的江面泛着微光，薄雾如轻纱般笼罩着街道，一切都显得那么宁静而安详，静静等待着第一缕晨光的唤醒。", "w03": "- Imagine you have a big task to solve.\n- You break it into a smaller version of the exact same task.\n- You keep doing this until the task is so tiny you can finish it immediately."}
